original: Problem Sleuth
translation: 问题侦探

original:
You are one of the top Problem Sleuths in the city. Solicitations for your service are numerous in quantity. Compensation, adequate. It is a balmy summer evening. You are feeling particularly hard boiled tonight.

What will you do?
translation:
本市顶尖的问题侦探里，你有一席之地。委托函件纷至沓来，酬金给的也颇合意。这个宜人夏夜，你感觉自己格外硬气。

你要怎么做？

original: Quickly retrieve arms from safe.
translation: 迅速从保险箱取回手臂

original: You've already got arms, numbnuts!
translation: 你已经有手臂了，笨蛋！

original: Retrieve your gun, there are dames to be rescued!
translation: 取回手枪，有贵妇人等着你去拯救呢！

original: You are quite positive there has never been a gun in your office, and never will be. Frankly, the notion strikes you as reckless and foolhardy.
translation: 你十分确信自己的办公室里从未出现过枪械，今后也绝不会有。坦白说，这种念头简直鲁莽到家，像个愣头青。

original: Break through glass with fist to unlock door.
translation: 用拳头击碎玻璃以打开门

original:
You don't know why you are assuming the door will be locked. You don't usually keep the door to your office locked. Nonetheless, a guy this hard boiled doesn't go messing around with totally unmanly things like knobs.

You send your meaty fist glass-ward.
translation:
你不明白自己为何认为门会上锁。平日你从不锁办公室的门。尽管如此像你这样硬气的爷本也不屑摆弄门把手这种娘们唧唧的玩意儿。

你砂锅大的拳头直冲玻璃砸去。

original: Thud.
translation: 嗵。

original: It seems there never was a glass element to the door. It was just a piece of paper taped to it.
translation: 门上压根就没有玻璃。那不过是贴着一张纸罢了。

original: Take the piece of paper.
translation: 拿上这张纸

original: The PIECE OF PAPER was added to your inventory.
translation: 这张纸加入了你的物品栏。

original: Manhandle the door knob, there are dames to be rescued!
translation: 撞开门把手，还有贵妇人等着你去拯救呢！

original: The door is locked!! Funny, you don't remember locking it.
translation: 门锁死了！有意思，你根本不记得曾经锁过它。

original: Call the royal locksmith!
translation: 把皇家锁匠叫来！

original: The most plainly obvious course of action is to call a locksmith. You examine the phone. While it appears to be hooked up to an active phone line, the rotary dial and receiver cord are both missing. You won't be talking to anyone on this phone!
translation: 眼下最明白不过的法子就是叫个锁匠。你检查电话机：虽然接通了线路，转盘和听筒线却都不翼而飞。这玩意可没法跟任何人通话！

original: Check pockets and desk drawers for phone parts
translation: 检查口袋和抽屉里有没有电话零件

original:
Unfortunately, your desk has no drawers, since it is a board resting on some cinderblocks with faux wood panel siding.

Your pocket however yields bountiful returns. You found some CANDY CORN.
translation:
可惜，你这桌子压根没抽屉。它只是几块煤渣砖撑起来的一块板子，贴着假木纹装饰。

不过口袋里倒是摸出不少好东西。你找到了些玉米糖。

original: Get key
translation: 拿钥匙

original:
You pick up the gun.

The grip is cold against your palm. This is your only friend in the world right now. It's gonna be a long night.
translation:
你拾起枪。

冰凉的枪柄贴着掌心。此刻它是你在这世上唯一的伙伴。今夜注定漫长。

original: Next
translation: 下一页

original: Store candy corn in safe
translation: 把玉米糖放进保险箱

original:
Thinking the precious cargo may not be secure in your pocket, you explore alternatives.

But you don't know the combination to the safe!! You figure it's probably hidden somewhere in your office.
translation:
你觉得这些宝贝疙瘩揣兜里可不稳妥，得另找个地方。

可你并不知道保险柜密码！！估摸着是藏在办公室的某处。

original: Check the other side of the paper.
translation: 检查纸的反面。

original: You have decided to examine PIECE OF PAPER.
translation: 你决定检阅这张纸。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页.

original: Eureka! You discovered a SEQUENCE OF NUMERALS.
translation: Eureka! 你发现了一串数字。

original: Open safe.
translation: 打开保险箱。

original: You will use SEQUENCE OF NUMERALS on the safe.
translation: 你将用对保险箱使用这串数字。

original: Next
translation: 下一页

original: The safe doesn't seem to work. It appears to be a replica of a safe's facade, concealing something beneath it on the wall.
translation: 保险箱没反应。似乎这只是一个假的保险箱壳子，用以把墙上什么东西藏在后面。

original: Next
translation: 下一页

original: There is a painting of a clown under the safe cover.
translation: 保险箱壳子后面有幅小丑的画。

original: Look under the fake wood paneling of the desk.
translation: 看桌子的假木板下面是什么

original: There is a flask of whiskey under the desk.
translation: 桌下有瓶威士忌。

original: Get ye flask.
translation: 拿瓶子

original: You pick up the FLASK OF WHISKEY.
translation: 你拾起威士忌酒瓶。

original: Drink the whisky and remember the good ol' days.
translation: 喝掉威士忌并回忆起往昔好时光

original: How do you expect to drink from the FLASK OF WHISKEY when it is not in your jacket pocket???
translation: 威士忌酒瓶还不在你的夹克口袋里，你怎么能指望喝到它呢？？

original: Exchange gun for whisky, then drink.
translation: 把枪换成酒，然后喝掉它

original: You swap the KEY for the FLASK OF WHISKEY, and wield it accordingly.
translation: 你将钥匙换成了威士忌酒瓶，并以对应的方式使用。

original: OW.
translation: 哎呦

original: You topple backwards on to your desk.
translation: 你向后一仰，摔在书桌上。

original: Use the key on the door and open it.
translation: 用钥匙开门

original:
You re-equip your GUN so you can blow a hole in the lock to open the door.

It looks like your GUN only has 1 BULLET(S) left. Are you sure you want to use it in this way? You might need it in case you have to off yourself later.
translation:
你重新装备手枪，以便轰开锁孔破门而出。

看上去枪膛里只剩最后一发子弹。确定要这样使用吗？或许待会儿你会需要它来了结自己。

original: Check what is taped to the bottom of the phone
translation: 检查电话机底部用胶带粘了什么东西

original: As you stoop to look at the bottom of the phone, your finger slips and you blow the lock off the door.
translation: 你弯下腰查看电话底部，这时手指一滑扣动板机，正好轰开门锁。

original: Never mind, what's under the phone?
translation: 无所谓了，电话下面是什么？

original: It is a business card for "Busts-R-Us". Probably a brothel, considering the lame double-entendre slogan, and the phone number, which if turned upside-down, spells "BOOBIES".
translation: 这是一张 Busts-R-Us 的名片。大概是家妓院，毕竟它的口号用了蹩脚的双关语，而且电话号码倒过来看会拼出 “BOOBIES”。

original: Take card.
translation: 拾起卡片。

original: You put the BUSTS-R-US CARD in your inventory. You also put the phone upright and back on its hook to make sure you don't miss any important calls from would-be clients.
translation: 你把Busts-R-Us卡片放进物品栏。你还把电话摆正并重新挂回听筒上，以确保不会错过任何潜在客户的重要来电。

original: Walk out of the room through the now unlocked door.
translation: 从现在开了锁的门走出去。

original: The door still will not open! It appears that it was never locked in the first place. Something must be obstructing its path.
translation: 门还是开不了！看样子它本来就没被锁住，是什么东西挡了路。

original: Look through the newly made hole in the door.
translation: 从门上开的洞里看出去。

original:
No wonder the door won't open. Blocking it is an enormous and magnificent bust of Ben Stiller in his role as Starsky in the 2004 retro-mania comedy remake of Starsky and Hutch.

Lying on the floor appears to be an unfortunate bystander, an employee of Busts-R-Us. He was polishing the bust right in front of your door for some reason.
translation:
难怪门打不开。挡在门口的是一座巨大的、气势非凡的本·斯蒂勒半身像，他在 2004 年复古狂热喜剧翻拍片《Starsky and Hutch》中饰演 Starsky 的造型。

地板上躺着一名不幸的路人，Busts-R-Us 的一名员工。他不知为何当时正好在你门口擦拭这座半身像。

original: Take the bust's sunglasses.
translation: 拿走胸像的墨镜。

original:
You can't reach them!!!

In any case, they are probably just a part of the statue, and not actual sunglasses.

You spend the next half hour trying to reach them.
translation:
你够不到它!!!

而且他们估计只是雕像的一部分，不是真正的墨镜

你把接下来半个小时都花在够墨镜上。

original: Take a closer look at the mysterious clown picture.
translation: 仔细地看看那个神秘小丑画作。

original: The painting is exquisite. There is something funny about his eyes though. Light seems to be shining through from the other side.
translation: 画面很精美。不过他的眼睛有点奇怪，似乎有光从另一边透过来。

original: Look through the eyes of the clown.
translation: 从小丑眼睛往外看。

original: It's too bright in this room to see anything in there! You do think you hear a voice though. You can't tell what it is saying.
translation: 你这个房间太亮，所以看不见对面的东西！不过你好像听见什么声音，可是听不清它在说什么。

original: Throw a cinderblock at the door.
translation: 把煤渣砖扔向门。

original:
You're just so angry about not being able to reach those sunglasses, you're about to lose it!

You first consolidate all the scrapped wood into a neat pile, then hoist the block towards the door.
translation:
够不到墨镜快要让你气炸了！

你先把所有的废木头收拢成一堆，然后把一块砖砸向门。

original: Next
translation: 下一页

original: It sounds like something was knocked loose on the other side.
translation: 听起来另一边什么东西松动了。

original: Peer out the window to see what floor you're on.
translation: 从窗户往外看，看看你在第几楼。

original:
You face EAST in the room to look out the window. Bright daylight floods the room through the glass. You've always been a stickler for natural light. This is the only source of light in the room.

What makes this particularly strange is the fact that it is 10 o'clock in the evening.
translation:
你面向房间的东边朝窗外望去。明亮的日光透过玻璃涌入室内。你一向是自然光的拥趸，这是屋子里唯一的光源。

奇怪的是，现在已经是晚上十点了。

original: Take a look outside.
translation: 看外面。

original: It's the view from your third floor office. You gaze abstractedly at the commotion below. Same scene, same faces every day. It's like it hardly ever changes. Not that you can afford to pay much attention to scenery, with your mind wrapped around the latest problem to sleuth, and your lips, around your flask.
translation: 这是你三楼办公室的景色。你心不在焉地凝视着楼下的喧闹。每天都是相同的场景，相同的面孔，几乎从未变化。不过心思纠缠着最新待破解的难题而嘴唇纠缠着酒瓶子的时候，你也无暇顾及风景。

original: Ask the movers with the moving van to remove Starsky statue.
translation: 让搬家卡车的搬运工挪走 Starsky 雕像。

original:
You shout toward the moving truck, hoping someone might be willing to bust your problem, so to speak.

You do your best pantomime of Ben Stiller as a Starsky statue. But it doesn't seem like anyone can see or hear you.
translation:
你朝那辆搬家卡车大喊，希望有人愿意来帮你“搞定”你的麻烦，姑且这么说。

你尽力模仿起扮演Starsky的本·斯蒂勒雕像的样子。可似乎没有人看见你，也没有人听见你。

original: Throw cinderblock at window, thereby discovering it is fake.
translation: 把煤渣砖扔向窗户从而发现它是假的

original: You think you have a pretty good idea about how your office works by now. Acting upon this hunch, you hoist another cinderblock glass-ward.
translation: 你觉得自己现在对办公室的运作方式已经有了相当清楚的认识。顺着这个直觉，你又抬起一块煤渣砖，朝着玻璃方向砸去。

original: Look.
translation: 看。

original: Pick up shard of glass and put it in your inventory.
translation: 拾起玻璃碎片放入物品栏。

original: No clue is too trivial for the keen problem sleuth. Your motto is "let no inventory go uncluttered".
translation: 对问题侦探而言，任何线索都不容忽视。你的座右铭是“让所有物品栏都整整齐齐”。

original: What's that?
translation: 那是什么？

original: You catch a glimpse of the reflection in the glass. It's the wall behind you.
translation: 你瞥见玻璃中的倒影，那是你后面的那堵墙。

original: Turn around.
translation: 转身。

original: Now facing SOUTH, you pause to marvel at the beauty of your office wall mural celebrating ethnic diversity. You had it commissioned some time ago by a promising young artist. Best $11,000 you ever spent!
translation: 此刻面朝南方，你驻足欣赏办公室墙壁上那幅颂扬民族多样性的巨幅壁画。这幅作品是你早些时候委托一位崭露头角的年轻艺术家创作的。绝对是你花过最值的一万一千美元！

original: Read the note under the coffee.
translation: 阅读咖啡壶下面的纸条。

original:
It appears to be another business card. At a glance, one might think it was a calling card for a lady of the night named "Muriel" with a typo in her name, given the poor spelling exhibited elsewhere.

But on closer inspection, it is more likely a misspelling for "mural", given the smudged-out pun about walls. The suggestion in the phone number is probably regarding the old coat of paint rather than anyone's clothes.

It's an easy enough mistake to make, though. You feel sorry for anyone who at any point in the past may have called while under the wrong impression.
translation:
这似乎又是一张商务名片。乍一看，人们可能会以为这是某个名叫“Muriel”的应召女郎的联系方式，只是名字里拼写出了错，毕竟这张卡片上其他地方的拼写也很差。

但仔细端详，"Muriel"更可能是"mural（壁画）"的误拼——尤其考虑到那条被涂模糊的关于墙壁的双关语。电话号码的暗示大概是指旧涂层涂料，而非任何人的衣着。

不过这种误会也情有可原。你不免替那些过去曾因误会而打过这个电话的人感到有些惋惜。

original: Using the chair, cinderblocks, and paneling, make a fort.
translation: 使用椅子、煤渣砖和板材，建造一个堡垒。

original: You stash the MADAME MUREL CARD in your inventory and set about making a really cool fort in your office! It is complete with a front step and a chimney. You are really proud of your craftsmanship.
translation: 你将“Murel女士”名片收进物品栏，开始在办公室里搭建超酷的堡垒！不仅配有门前台阶，还竖起了烟囱。你对自己的手艺感到无比自豪。

original: Use your imagination to play make-believe.
translation: 发挥想象玩假装游戏。

original: Inside your fort, you are only bound by the walls of your imagination, and several small pieces of particle board.
translation: 在你的堡垒里，唯一的边界就是你的想象力，以及几小片刨花板。

original: Fantasize.
translation: 现在是，幻想时间。

original:
This is what being a hard boiled problem sleuth is all about. It's about being a strong, silent type, oozing with confidence, charisma, and other fine qualities such as not being trapped in your own office. It's about having a working phone. A real desk. Not one, but two steak dinners. And some hysterical broad on the line, yackin' about some fella she's got troubles with. It's always the same thing with dames. You comfort yourself in your sublime fantasy by now and then saying things into the phone such as, "Now calm down a second, toots..." and "Hey, take it easy, sweetheart. I can barely understand a word you're sayin'..."

RING-RING.

Your call is rudely interrupted by a ringing noise. It can't be the phone, because you're already on it!
translation:
这就是当一个硬派的问题侦探的真谛。要做那种沉稳寡言的角色，浑身往外渗着自信、魅力，以及其他优秀品质——比如，不会被困在自己的办公室里。得有一部能接通的电话，一张实木办公桌，不是一份而是两份牛排大餐。电话那头还有个歇斯底里的娘们，哭哭啼啼说着她遇上的麻烦事儿。女人永远都这个样子。你靠这种美妙的幻想安慰自己，不时对着电话说几句"冷静点小可爱..."或者"嘿放轻松甜心，你哭得我一个字都听不清了..."

铃—铃—

通话被刺耳的铃声粗暴打断。不可能是电话铃响，你明明正通着话呢！

original: RING-RING.
translation: 铃—铃—

original: Something is ringing in your office.
translation: 办公室里什么东西在铃铃响。

original: Check it out.
translation: 检查一下。

original: Answer the phone in a very hard-boiled way.
translation: 硬派地回复电话。

original: You pick up the phone and mutter some impatient greetings into the useless receiver. There is no response. Looks like you just lost another client to technical difficulties.
translation: 你抄起听筒对着废物接收器咕哝了几句不耐烦的问候语。没有回答。看起来你又因技术故障失去了一个潜在客户。

original: Throw the devil phone out the window.
translation: 把邪恶电话扔出窗外。

original: You are fed up with your shitty phone. It has screwed you out of a case for the last time!
translation: 你受够了这个破烂电话。这是它最后一次搅黄你的生意！

original: Go look.
translation: 看一眼。

original: You're probably going to need to get that back somehow.
translation: 你以后说不定还得把它弄回来。

original: Crack open window.
translation: 破开窗户。

original:
Even though the window is broken, you decide to open it.

You slide the lower pane upward, but the whole window frame seems to slip from its anchored position.
translation:
尽管窗户已经碎掉，你还是决定打开它。

你向上滑动底部窗板，但整个窗框似乎都要从原来位置脱落下来。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页.

original: The window comes off the wall altogether. On closer examination, it seems to be a false window with a picture inside it. The picture is lit from within, sort of like a sophisticated light box.
translation: 那扇窗整个儿从墙上脱落了。仔细一看，原来那只是个假壳子，里面嵌着一幅画。画面由内部打光，算是个精致的灯箱。

original: Put window down.
translation: 放下窗。

original:
The window/light box is plugged into the wall behind it.

The false window was concealing a large safe.
translation:
这个窗户/灯箱在后面的墙上插着线。

原来假窗户后面藏着一个大号保险箱。

original: Place false window in inventory.
translation: 把假窗户置入物品栏。

original:
The false window is way too big to carry around, stupid!

But you did find a CURTAIN ROD just under the top edge. You never did get around to putting up drapes. Then again, it never did make much sense to cover up the only source of light in your office.

You put the CURTAIN ROD in your inventory.
translation:
这扇假窗户太大了，根本没法随身带着，你这蠢蛋！

不过你倒是在窗户里面上沿发现了一根窗帘杆。你一直没装过窗帘。再说了，把办公室里唯一的光源遮住，本来也说不通。

你把窗帘杆放进了物品栏。

original: Use numbers from sheet of paper to open the safe.
translation: 用纸上的数字打开保险箱。

original: You examine the heavy-duty safe. You must be keeping some serious loot in here.
translation: 你检查那只沉重的保险箱。里面肯定锁着一些正经好货。

original: Enter the combination.
translation: 输入密码。

original:
You enter the SEQUENCE OF NUMERALS from the PIECE OF PAPER. The combination works!

However, instead of opening the safe, the dial has simply popped open to reveal a keyhole. It looks like it requires a key that looks more like a house key or a car key, rather than one of those old fashioned looking keys which tend to be littered all over video games, and which you are quite sure you have never once seen lying around in your office.

You don't need this PIECE OF PAPER anymore.
translation:
你输入来自那张纸上的数字序列，密码有效！

然而，保险箱并没有打开，旋钮只是弹开，露出了一个锁孔。看起来需要的钥匙更像是房门钥匙或车钥匙，而不是那种电子游戏里随处可见的老式钥匙。你很确定，在你的办公室里，从来没见过那种东西随便丢在什么地方。

你再也不需要那张纸了。

original: Crumple it up and throw it away.
translation: 把它团一团扔了。

original: You discarded the PIECE OF PAPER.
translation: 你丢弃了那张纸。

original: Shoot safe.
translation: 射击保险箱。

original: Your KEY is out of bullets!!!
translation: 你的钥匙已经用光了子弹！！！

original: Get cinderblock and phone receiver out of false window.
translation: 从假窗里拿回煤渣砖和接收器。

original: It's a long way down! You'll have to think of a way to reel them in if you want them back.
translation: 它们在很下面呢！如果你还想要它们，就得弄根绳子钓上来。

original: Unplug the window to conserve electricity.
translation: 拔掉窗户的电线以节省电力。.

original:
You unplug the false window, which is probably burning through electricity with its powerful fluorescent bulbs and strange spatial warping properties. You're not made of money!

The room goes dark.
translation:
你拔掉了假窗户的插头，它这么亮肯定在用超级荧光灯泡和奇怪的空间扭曲特性消耗着大量电力。你可没钱供它烧！

房间暗了下去。

original: Look through the eyes of the clown.
translation: 从小丑眼睛往外看。

original: With the room darkened, you should now be able to see through the painting.
translation: 随着房间暗下去，你现在可以看到画像对面。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页.

original:
Gadzooks! It's another urban mural. This one is particularly unpleasant. You have a feeling it might have been placed there just to annoy you.

You hear a voice from the other side. It's hard to tell what it is saying, but you think you can make out the words "toots" and "sweatheart" now and then.

It's hard to tell how far away the mural is. The clown's eyes are so close together, you can only see through one at a time, limiting your depth perception. You wonder what kind of freak this painting was made for.

If only you had some sort of thin, extendable implement to poke through the hole to tell how far away it is.
translation:
嗨呀！又是一幅都市壁画。这一幅格外令人不快。你感觉它好像就是故意画在这里来惹恼你的。

你听到另一边传来一个声音。很难辨清它在说什么，但你觉得偶尔能听出“宝贝”和“甜心”这样的词。

很难判断这幅壁画究竟有多远。小丑的双眼离得很近，你一次只能透过一只眼睛看出去，所以感知不了远近深度。你不禁想，这幅画究竟是给什么怪人准备的。

要是你手里有某种细长、可以伸缩的工具，能戳穿那个洞探探距离就好了。

original: Push the curtain rod through one of the clown's eye holes.
translation: 把窗帘杆从小丑的一个眼洞里捅出去。

original: You feel the the CURTAIN ROD bump into something not too far into the wall.
translation: 你感觉窗帘杆没戳多远就碰上了什么东西。

original: Get a look at the unobstructed view.
translation: 没有遮挡了，再看一眼。

original: It is the adjacent office. The man at the desk is talking to a client about some sort of problem which requires sleuthing.
translation: 是隔壁的办公室。桌旁的男人正在和某位客户谈论什么需要侦探的问题。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: It is your loathesome arch nemesis, Ace Dick! He is always scooping you on the best cases. That portly son of a bitch makes your blood boil!
translation: 那是你可憎的死对头，王牌老屌！他总是抢在你前面接下最好的案子。这死猪气得你血压直飙！

original: Shout insults at Ace Dick through the clown painting.
translation: 隔着小丑画辱骂王牌老屌

original:
You shout, but he cannot hear you. The walls may be too thick, or he is just engrossed in his conversation. It sounds like he is arguing over a misunderstanding about the nature of the services provided by Busts-R-Us, and an alarmingly large bill for those services.

In the darkness, you stub your toe on the false safe cover. You utter more profanity.
translation:
你大声喊叫，但他听不见你。可能是墙壁太厚，或者他只是专心于自己的谈话。听起来他正在争论关于 Busts-R-Us 提供服务性质的某种误会，以及那份数额惊人的账单。

在黑暗中，你的脚趾撞上了那个假的保险箱盖。你忍不住又骂了几句脏话。

original: Plug the damn window back in.
translation: 把那个傻逼窗户插回去。

original: Inflated electric bills or not, you are getting sick of stubbing your toe on things.
translation: 管他电费飙多高，撞脚趾头你可是受够了。

original: Drop kick the door.
translation: 下压踢这扇门。

original: The door bears the brunt of the bottled-up shitstorm brewing within.
translation: 这扇门承受着你胸中酝酿已久的操蛋怒火风暴。

original: Examine aftermath of shitstorm.
translation: 检查操蛋怒火留下的结果。

original: The key which you can't actually see, and don't actually know is there, jingled a bit. You'll have to throw something heavier against the door if you want to knock it loose.
translation: 那把钥匙——其实你根本看不见，也不知道它真的在那里——轻轻晃动了一下。要想把它震下来，你得往门上扔点更重的东西。

original: Throw cinderblock at the door.
translation: 把煤渣砖扔向门。

original: You take the cinderblock which was formerly your fort's front step. You decided you could stand to part with it, since you've been stubbing your toe on it constantly since you built it.
translation: 你拿起了那块曾经是你堡垒前台阶的水泥砖。你觉得是时候放手了，毕竟自从建起它以来你就老是撞着脚趾头。

original: KLUNK.
translation: 哐啷。

original: The key still won't jingle loose. It looks like you'll need to throw an even heavier object at the door.
translation: 钥匙还是不松动。看样子你得朝着门扔更重的东西。

original: Check out what's on the false safe.
translation: 检查假保险箱上面的东西。

original: Since Ace seems so intent on being able to see into your office, it looks like you put up something for him to look at.
translation: 既然老屌这么喜欢偷窥你的办公室，似乎你也为他专门摆了点东西看。

original: Take the note.
translation: 拿上纸条。

original: You stashed the NOTE TO ACE DICK.
translation: 你把给王牌老屌的纸条收好。

original: Investigate coffee machine-looking object in the corner.
translation: 调查角落形似咖啡机的东西。

original: It appears to be some kind of heating unit to keep the coffee hot. It looks heavy.
translation: 这似乎是什么用于给咖啡保温的加热单元。看着很沉。

original: Pick it up.
translation: 带上它。

original:
It is quite heavy. And hot!

You contemplate throwing it at the door, but something occurs to you first. You don't want to knock the keys on the floor and not be able to reach them. (re: the sunglasses fiasco) You'd better be prepared to catch them in something after you throw it.
translation:
它好沉。而且好烫！

你正打算把它扔向门，但先想到一件事。你可不想把钥匙打落在地上却够不着它们。（参见：墨镜事件）你最好准备好用什么东西接住钥匙再扔。

original: Use hat as a key net, then throw coffee maker.
translation: 用帽子接住钥匙，然后扔咖啡机。

original: You resolve to catch the key with your hat. You let the ponderous appliance fly.
translation: 你决定用帽子接住钥匙。你让这台笨重机器起飞了。

original: Catch the key.
translation: 接住钥匙。

original: With quick reflexes, you shove your hat through the hole in time to rescue the key.
translation: 凭着敏捷的反应，你及时把帽子塞进洞里，成功救下了钥匙。

original: Pull hat back in.
translation: 把帽子拉回来。

original: You got the SAFE KEY! And you can't think of a safer place for it than where it is now.
translation: 你得到了保险箱钥匙！而且它在最保险的地方了。

original: Play back message on the reel to reel.
translation: 重放磁带录音机的信息。

original: You keep the hidden recording device in your office to record anything said that might be incriminating. Unfortunately, the only incriminating statements it recorded were likely made by yourself.
translation: 你把那个隐藏的录音装置留在办公室，用来记录任何可能有罪证的话。不幸的是，它记录下的唯一可能有罪证的言论好像都是你自己说的。

original: Swap the safe key with the candy corn.
translation: 交换保险箱钥匙和玉米糖。

original:
Your prized confections will be safer here.

The recording tape begins to unspool while you're preoccupied.
translation:
你珍藏的甜点在这里会更安全。

在你分神的时候，录音带散出来了。

original: Pee through the clown eyes into ace dick's office.
translation: 从小丑眼洞里尿到王牌老屌的办公室里。

original:
You remember you're pissed off at Ace Dick, and in addition to which, you haven't been able to pee once in the 13 and a half hours you've been locked in your office. You decide to exact revenge by unleashing a torrent of urine through one of the painting holes, preferably while he is spying on you.

Unfortunately, your aim isn't that good, and you don't even come close to getting pee through the holes. The painting is now a smelly mess.
translation:
你想起自己正对王牌老屌气得要命，再加上被困在办公室的十三个半小时里你一次都没能解手。于是你决定报复一下，从画上的一个洞里倾泻出一股尿流，最好正好在他偷窥的时候。

不幸的是，你的准头实在不怎么样，甚至完全没能把尿对准洞口。结果这幅画现在成了一团散发恶臭的烂摊子。

original: Use the key on the safe.
translation: 对保险箱使用钥匙。

original:
You unlock the safe with the SAFE KEY. The safe opens to reveal a hidden room.

You don't need the SAFE KEY anymore, so you discard it.
translation:
你用保险箱钥匙解锁了保险箱。保险箱打开，显露出一个密室。

你不再需要保险箱钥匙了，所以扔了它。

original: Wrap yourself in recording tape like a mummy.
translation: 用磁带把自己包成木乃伊。

original: Wow, what a fucking waste of time!
translation: 哇袄，真是浪费时间！

original: Barge into the room with wild abandon.
translation: 毫无顾忌地闯进房间。

original: You enter your secret chamber. It's a dark alcove you use to store a few modest valuables, and duck into whenever you're on a case and things start to get too hot to handle (which is never).
translation: 你走进密室。这是一个黑暗的壁龛，用来存放一些不算贵重的财物。办案时一旦局势过于棘手（实际上从未有过）你就会蹲进去。

original: Check out the paper on the floor.
translation: 检查地上的纸。

original:
It appears to be a note delivered to you from Ace Dick. It smells a little like pee. You hate him so much.

You stash the UNPLEASANT NOTE in your inventory.
translation:
似乎是王牌老屌送给你的一张纸条。问起来有股尿味。你真是恨死他了。.

你把讨厌的纸条塞进物品栏。

original: Play a haunting tuba refrain.
translation: 演奏一段扰人心弦的大号乐章。

original: You can't do it. That tuba is filthy!
translation: 你不能这么做。这大号臭死了！

original: Check out the paper on the wall.
translation: 检查墙上的纸。

original: It's another business card for an intriguing trade. Some of these services sound really exotic.
translation: 又是一张奇特交易的商业名片。这些服务里有些听起来真是相当异乎寻常。

original: Put card in your inventory.
translation: 把卡片放进物品栏。

original: Get in dummy elevator.
translation: 走进傻瓜电梯。

original: You climb into the elevator, sometimes called a dumbwaiter. It's pitch black inside. There's only one direction to go.
translation: 你爬进电梯，有时也叫做小货梯。里面漆黑一片。只有一个方向可以去。

original: Go down.
translation: 向下。

original:
The dumbwaiter goes down a little bit, then stops. This is as far as it goes.

The interior is somewhat illuminated from light coming in through a slit on the wall you're facing. It looks like you can slip objects through it, as long as they are narrow enough.
translation:
小货梯向下移动一点儿，停住了。它就能走这么远。

一道光线从你面前的一块缝隙透进，稍微照亮了电梯内部。看起来你可以把东西从那儿塞出去，只要它们足够细。

original: Peep through the slit.
translation: 从缝隙往外看。

original: It's hard to see anything through it. But you hear a voice again.
translation: 几乎看不见任何东西。但是你又听见声音了。

original: Listen.
translation: 听。

original: It's Ace Dick's office again. He is still on the phone and sounds really surly. He seems quite upset about a mixup involving large stone busts, instead of some other service he believed he was getting.
translation: 又是王牌老屌的办公室。他还在打电话，听起来相当暴躁。似乎他因为搞混了什么东西而恼火不已——涉及的是巨大的石雕半身像，而不是他原以为会得到的其他服务。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: He seems to be wondering if he has the right business card.
translation: 他似乎在想自己是否有正确的名片。

original: Feed your "BUSTS-R-US" card through slot.
translation: 通过缝隙给出Busts-R-Us名片。

original: You deposit into the slot the BUSTS-R-US card.
translation: 你把Busts-R-Us名片递过缝隙。

original: But pee on the card beforehand.
translation: 但是，先在上面尿尿。

original:
A little too late, you realize you should have peed on the card to stick it to Ace.

You decide to pee on it anyway.
translation:
有些晚了，你意识到自己本该在给老屌的卡片上尿一泡的。

你觉得不管怎样还是来一发。

original: CUT SCENE
translation: 转场。

original: Ace Dick picks up the card and puts it in his inventory. He considers the card carefully.
translation: 王牌老屌拾起卡片放进了自己的物品栏。他仔细打量着这张卡。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: He calls the number, hoping this one will bring satisfaction.
translation: 他拨打上面的号码，希望有个满意的结果。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: After a little while, some whores show up.
translation: 过了一小会儿，来了几个娼妓。

original: END CUT SCENE.
translation: 结束转场。

original: It looks like Ace got the better of you once again.
translation: 看上去老屌又摆了你一道。

original: Take swig from FLASK OF WHISKEY.
translation: 畅饮那瓶威士忌。

original:
Feelings of dejection overwhelm you. You are tired of being shown up by your rival. He gets everything. All the good cases. The women. The ability to open his office door. You'd wager he even enjoys the lion's share of the candy corn.

You down a stiff belt from your FLASK OF WHISKEY.

You experience a boost in your IMAGINATION.
translation:
沮丧感将你淹没。你已厌倦被对手抢尽风头——他得到了一切：所有好案子、女人、自由开阖办公室门的能力。你甚至敢打赌，连玉米糖都是他分走最大份。

你从威士忌酒壶中灌下一口烈酒。

你的想象力获得了提升。

original: Clean horns.
translation: 清理号角。

original:
Suddenly, you are entirely dissatisfied with the condition of these horns. It is an absolute disgrace. You won't stand for it.

You set about polishing the instruments, but it seems your IMAGINATION is too high to conduct normal day-to-day activities. You topple some of the horns. The clarinet breaks.

If only there were a place that could serve as a proper outlet for such a high degree of IMAGINATION until the condition passed.
translation:
突然间，你对这些铜管乐器的状态感到极度不满。这简直是奇耻大辱。你决不容忍这种情况继续下去。

你着手打磨这些乐器，但似乎你的想象力过高，无法进行日常活动。你碰倒了几支号角，单簧管也摔坏了。

要是能有个地方让你宣泄这般汹涌的想象力，直到这种状态平息就好了。

original: Back to the ol' fort!
translation: 回到老堡垒去！

original:
In your heightened state of IMAGINATION, you fall down the stairs.

You'd better get to the safety of your fort fast. You're no good to anyone out here.
translation:
你在高度活跃的想象力驱使下滚下了楼梯。

你最好赶快回到堡垒的安全地带。待在外面对谁都不好。

original: Hurry!
translation: 快点！

original: You feel safe and sound in the cozy confines of your wobbly particle board walls.
translation: 在摇摇晃晃的颗粒板墙围成的舒适空间里，你感到无比安心踏实。

original: Drift into realm of make-believe.
translation: 沉浸在白日梦的境界。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original:
You stand in your imaginary office. With the mind, anything is possible.

Your imaginary phone is ringing.
translation:
你站在想象中的办公室里。有想象力一切皆有可能。

你想象中的电话响了。

original: Answer the imaginary phone.
translation: 接想象中的电话。

original:
You answer the phone in the best Depression-era fast-talking way possible. On the other line is a hysterical dame.

You tell her to calm down and give you the skinny on what all hubbub is about. Her answers are vague and one-dimensional. The case is quickly going nowhere.

It turns out your imagination sucks!
translation:
你以最佳的大萧条时期快语速方式接起电话。电话那头是一位歇斯底里的女士。

你让她冷静下来，告诉你这场骚动究竟是怎么回事。她的回答含糊且单薄。案件很快陷入了僵局。

原来你的想象力糟透了！

original: Eat steak dinners with hands.
translation: 用手吃牛排晚餐。

original: The steak dinners have been sitting around for a while. They are both spoiled!
translation: 牛排已经在这待了老长时间。它们全都腐坏了！

original: Gorge yourself on imaginary candy corn.
translation: 大吃特吃想象中的玉米糖。

original:
They don't taste as good as real candy corn.

Nevertheless, it gives your PULCHRITUDE a small boost.
translation:
它们吃起来不如真的玉米糖。

尽管如此，它还是少量提升了你的魅力。

original: Try to take imaginary gun back into real world.
translation: 尝试把想象中的枪带回现实世界。

original:
You pick up the gun.

You'd like to bring it back with you, but you cannot fathom how that is possible.
translation:
你捡起枪。

你也愿意把它一起带走，可是你想不到这怎么可能。

original: Stride confidently through office door.
translation: 自信地大步走出办公室。

original: You exit your office, into the hallway.
translation: 你离开办公室，进入走廊。

original: Go harass Ace Dick.
translation: 去骚扰王牌老屌。

original:
You burst through Ace Dick's imaginary door, rolling up your nonexistent sleeves.

But he is nowhere to be found. His imaginary room is empty, most likely because Ace is currently not using his IMAGINATION.
translation:
你冲进王牌老屌那想象中的房门，卷起你想象中的袖子。

可他本人却不见踪影。他想象中的房间是空的，很可能是因为老屌没有在使用他的想象力。

original: Leave room.
translation: 离开房间。

original: You exit, but not before you leave and imaginary present on the floor.
translation: 你离开了，但这之前，你留下一份想象中的礼物。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: You are now facing SOUTH in the hallway.
translation: 你现在面向走廊南边。

original: Enter the P.I. room.
translation: 进入P.I.房间。

original:
You hear noises behind the door. It sounds like swing music, and riotous times being had. Whoever is in this office probably has a terrific imagination!

But the door is locked.
translation:
门后传来阵阵声响。你听见摇摆舞乐，想必是在纵情狂欢。这间办公室的主人一定有着绝妙的想象力！

但门被锁住了。

original: Follow the EXIT sign.
translation: 跟着出口标识走。

original:
You feel your IMAGINATION beginning to fade, so you hurry downstairs to the imaginary street.

You find your motley collection of items which you earlier threw out the window in a fit of rage, stupidity, or both.
translation:
你感觉自己的想象力渐渐消退，于是赶忙下楼到想象中的街道去。

你发现了一堆乱七八糟的物品，就是你刚才出于一时愤怒或者犯蠢，或者两者皆具的情绪从窗户丢出去的那些。

original: Look up at your office window.
translation: 抬头看你办公室的窗户。

original: You see a familiar face through the window. A friendly face.
translation: 你透过窗户看到一张熟悉的脸。一张友善的脸。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: Your IMAGINATION wears off.
translation: 你的想象力消散了。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original:
You experience the lingering effects of your IMAGINATION. The stat remains at the same level, but no longer affords you its advantages. However, you remain just as useless in the real world!

You are going to need to figure out a way to sober up fast.
translation:
你感到想象力对你的影响挥之不去。属性维持在相同水平，但不再为你提供优势。然而，你在现实世界中依然一无是处！

你需要想个办法让自己快点清醒过来。

original: Chug coffee with no regard for temperature.
translation: 不管咖啡烫不烫，都咕咚咕咚的猛灌。

original:
You drink the COFFEE which is lukewarm. It is foul, bitter, and ridiculously strong. You can only drink a little of it.

Your IMAGINATION is reduced, while your VIM enjoys a healthy boost. You feel terrific now! Fit as a fiddle, and bristling with coordination.

Two pieces of CANDY CORN fall on to the floor.
translation:
你喝下温吞的咖啡。这咖啡又苦又涩，浓得离谱，只能勉强咽下几口。

你的想象力被削减，但精力却显著提振。你现在感觉好极了！精神也抖擞，身手也敏捷。

两粒玉米糖掉在了地上。

original: Get candy corn.
translation: 拿玉米糖。

original:
You put the CANDY CORN into your HAT.

The phone is ringing again.
translation:
你把玉米糖放进帽子。

电话又在响了。

original: Go check it out.
translation: 去检查。

original:
Your phone is now missing three components, making it that much more difficult to answer this call from an undoubtedly hysterical dame.

If only you could think of a way to reel in objects from the weird window/mind-space universe.
translation:
你的手机现在少了三个部件，接这通来自一位显然歇斯底里的女士的电话变得愈发困难。

要是你能想到办法从那个诡异的窗口/意识空间宇宙里把东西钓回来就好了。

original: Flip window upside-down and shake to retrieve phone.
translation: 把窗户倒过来摇晃以取回电话。

original: You try to shake your belongings from the blasted portal.
translation: 你试图从炸毁的传送门里取回你的东西。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: It appears to run on Etch-A-Sketch technology.
translation: 它似乎是靠蚀刻素描技术运转的。

original: Make lasso out of tape and pull phone back in.
translation: 用胶带做个锁套，把手机拉回来。

original:
You use the magnetic tape to form a lasso. Maybe you can reel in your belongings this way.

However, you think the tape-lasso is way too light and flimsy to throw out the window with any significant distance or accuracy. You'll need something to weigh it down.
translation:
你用磁带做了个套索，或许能用它把东西捞上来。

但这磁带套索实在太轻太软，根本没法扔出窗外多远，更别说准头了。你得找个东西增加它的重量。

original: Cut to the chase and use cinderblock.
translation: 直奔主题并使用煤渣块吧。

original: You tie the tape to a cinderblock, using it as an anchor.
translation: 你把煤渣砖绑到磁带上，作为一个锚。

original: Throw out window.
translation: 扔出窗外。

original: Examine the mural for hidden clues.
translation: 检查壁画有没有隐藏线索。

original: It looks like there are two holes in the mural. They are spaced far apart, just wide enough for someone with sensible human anatomy to look through with both eyes.
translation: 壁画上似乎有两个孔洞。它们间距适中，刚好够一个人体结构正常的人用双眼同时窥视。

original: Look through them.
translation: 从孔洞看过去。

original: You unplug the window again and have a gander.
translation: 你又拔掉窗户插头，瞥过去看。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: It's an UNPLEASANT NOTE. You can tell using your DEPTH PERCEPTION that the note is very close, only a few inches from your face.
translation: 是一张讨厌的纸条。你的远近深度感知判断纸条很近，与你的脸只有几英寸距离。

original: Poke curtain rod at note.
translation: 用窗帘杆戳纸条。

original:
A painting of an elf jostles on the other side.

It falls to reveal a safe.

The safe pops open, revealing a painting of an elf.
translation:
一副画着精灵的画挤在另一边。

它掉下来，后面露出一只保险箱。

保险箱突然地打开了，里面是一幅画着精灵的画。

original: Look through elf holes.
translation: 从精灵画的洞口看过去。

original:
It is the office of yet another one of your competitors, Pickle Inspector. He looks dazed, as if perhaps he's been trapped in his office for some time.

There are strange glass containers in the corner. You wonder if there might be a business card (worded professionally, of course) for a glass blower somewhere in his office. Perhaps taped to something, like a cinderblock, or the back of an elf painting.

His office is dark for some reason.
translation:
这是你的另一个竞争对手，咸菜探员的办公室。他看起来很茫然，好像被困在自己的办公室里有一段时间了。

角落里有一些奇怪的玻璃容器。你想知道在他办公室的某个地方是否会有一张吹玻璃工的名片（当然，是写得很专业的那种）。也许它会粘在什么东西上，比如煤渣砖，或者精灵画的背面。

不知为何，他的办公室暗暗的。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: You suddenly hear noises coming from Ace Dick's office. You figure as long as your office is dark, you might as well check on him through the clown holes.
translation: 你突然听见王牌老屌的办公室那里传来什么动静。你想到，既然你的办公室暗下来了，你或许也能从小丑眼洞里看看他那一边。

original: Take a look.
translation: 看一眼。

original: The whores tied Ace Dick up in a chair and stole his phone. The Huggy Bear bust is cracked open, and the treasure which was undoubtedly stashed inside has been stolen too. He was probably tortured for the information.
translation: 妓女们把王牌老屌绑在椅子上，还偷走了他的电话。那尊 Huggy Bear 半身像已经被砸开，里面无疑藏着的宝物也被洗劫一空。他大概是被拷问出情报的。

original: REJOICE!
translation: 庆祝！

original: You celebrate by mustering one of the silliest dances you've attempted in hours.
translation: 你幸灾乐祸地跳起了几个小时以来你所尝试过的最滑稽的舞步之一。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: Ace Dick hears your shenanigans from the other side. He seems to be pleading for a way to cut the rope.
translation: 王牌老屌从另一边听见你这些动静。他似乎在寻求什么办法来砍断绳子。

original: Try to get the Hutch bust's attention.
translation: 尝试吸引Hutch半身像的注意。

original:
You can't imagine how you can get a statue's attention.

You begin to covet the Hutch bust, and whatever secrets it guards.
translation:
你想象不出怎么能吸引一尊雕像的注意力。

你觊觎着Hutch半身像，以及里面的不管什么秘密。

original: Climb down the tape to retrieve your things.
translation: 沿着磁带爬下去取回你的东西。

original: The reel is way too weak to hold your weight! It will probably only be able to support and reel in lighter objects.
translation: 磁带绳太脆弱，根本承受不了你的重量！它大概只能支撑并收回一些较轻的物品。

original: Activate the reel-to-reel.
translation: 启动磁带录音机。

original: The reel begins to turn, pulling the tape taught. The cinderblock below does not budge. If the tape is re-tied to a lighter object, it will likely be pulled in through the window automatically.
translation: 绳轴开始转动，把胶带绷紧了。下面的煤渣砖纹丝不动。要是把胶带重新系在一个更轻的物品上，它很可能就会被自动拉进窗户里。

original: Give Ace piece of glass to cut rope.
translation: 给老屌一块碎玻璃来割绳子。

original: You go into the back room and down the elevator.
translation: 你走进后屋，随电梯下行。

original: Slip glass through slot.
translation: 把玻璃递出缝隙。

original: Ace receives the SHARD OF GLASS. He uses it to cut himself free.
translation: 老屌得到了玻璃碎片。他割断绳子得到自由。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original:
You are now Ace Dick.

You begin to question this feud you've been embroiled in with your neighbor for so long. After all, he did just give you the number for some honest to God whores, even if they did ultimately rob you. He also just helped you escape. Maybe it's time to bury the hatchet and help him out of his office.

You feel you should get some supplies from your safe first, though. If only you could remember the combination.
translation:
你现在是 王牌老屌。

你开始反思起自己和邻居之间这场纠缠已久的恩怨。毕竟，他刚刚确实给了你一些真正的妓女的联系方式——虽然最后她们确实抢了你。再说他刚刚还帮你逃了出来。也许是时候冰释前嫌，助他离开办公室了。

不过，你觉得还是应该先从自己的保险箱里取些补给。要是你能想起密码就好了。

original: Check behind paper stuck to door for combo.
translation: 检查粘在门上的纸背面有没有密码。

original: You can't pull it off! It's stuck fast. Maybe a heavy object will knock it loose.
translation: 你没法把它撕下来！它粘的很紧。也许什么重物可以把它敲松。

original: Throw Hutch bust at it.
translation: 把Hutch半身像扔过去。

original: Using your extraordinary strength due to your unusually high VIM characteristic, you lift the bust easily.
translation: 凭借你那异常高的 精力 属性所带来的非凡力量，你轻而易举地举起了这尊半身像。

original: Throw.
translation: 扔。

original: You send the Owen Wilson paper-ward.
translation: 你向那张纸扔出Owen Wilson。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original:
The bust crashed through the window, knocking out an employee of Madame Murel. He was wheeling a portable scaffold into place to prepare for some more mural work. He looks like he's in bad shape now.

The Hutch head cracked open, exposing riches.

It looks like one of the whores may have taken Starsky's sunglasses.
translation:
半身像砸穿了窗户，撞倒了 Madame Murel 的一名员工。他正推着一架便携脚手架准备进行更多的壁画作业。现在看起来他伤得不轻。

Hutch 的头裂开了，有财宝从中露出来。

看来那几个妓女里有人把 Starsky 的墨镜拿走了。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: The scaffold continues rolling, coming to a stop in front of your door, jamming it shut.
translation: 脚手架还在滚动，最后停到你房门前，死死堵住了门。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original:
You are now trapped in your office too. You and Problem Sleuth will have to work together if you want to escape.

(Precede commands for Ace Dick with "AD:", and for Problem Sleuth with "PS:".)
translation:
现在你也被困办公室了。如果想逃脱，你和问题侦探将必须合作。

（使用“AD:”开头的指令命令王牌老屌，对问题侦探则用“PS”。）

original: AD: Reach through window and move scaffolding out of the way
translation: AD：探出窗外挪走脚手架。

original:
The scaffolding is jammed in place! It seems the brake for the wheels was triggered after it came to a stop. You can't push it away either. The top just bumps up against the ceiling. There's no climbing out of the window with your portly frame because of the scaffold bars.

Unless someone comes to help you, or you find a blowtorch to melt through the bars, you're probably not getting out of this office any time soon. Nice try though!
translation:
脚手架被卡死在原地了！好像是在停下后，轮子的刹车被触发了。你也推不倒它。顶部正好顶到天花板上。由于脚手架的横杆挡着，你那臃肿的身躯根本没法从窗户爬出去。

除非有人来帮你，或者你找到一把喷灯把横杆熔开，否则你短时间内大概是别想离开办公室了。不过，尝试总是值得的！

original: Ok, forget it then.
translation: 行吧，那算了。

original: AD: Pick up tommy gun.
translation: AD：拾起冲锋枪。

original: I beg your pardon?
translation: 抱歉，你说什么？

original: AD: Get the phone pieces sitting around.
translation: AD：收起四处的电话零件。

original: You put the PHONE PARTS in your inventory.
translation: 你把电话零件放入物品栏。

original: AD: Slip PS his phone parts.
translation: AD：把电话零件送给PS。

original: You slip the PHONE PARTS through the slot to an awaiting Problem Sleuth.
translation: 你把电话零件顺着缝隙塞给了等待已久的问题侦探。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original:
But he is not waiting for them in the dumbwaiter!!

The phone parts fall somewhere into the dark shaft below. Nice work, Bonehead McFuckup.
translation:
但他此刻并不在小货梯里！！

电话零件掉进了下面黑暗的电梯井。干的漂亮，搞砸大笨蛋先生。

original: AD: Look inside Huggy Bear statue for riches.
translation: AD：在Huggy Bear半身像里搜寻财宝。

original: There is a HAMMER in the broken Snoop Dogg bust. You place the HAMMER in your inventory.
translation: 在破洞的Snoop Dogg雕像里有个锤子。你把锤子放进物品栏。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: PS: Climb halfway out window, then unplug window.
translation: PS：把半个身子探出窗外，然后给窗户断电。

original:
The window loses it's extra-dimensional portal properties, and severs you mid-way through. You are dead.

<- GO BACK
translation:
窗户失去了它的多维度特质，把你一切两半。你死了。

<-回退

original: No wait, don't do that.
translation: 等等，别这么做。

original: You're not sure what you were thinking.
translation: 你不清楚自己在想什么。

original: PS: Check behind clown poster.
translation: 检查小丑海报后面。

original:
Behind the poster is another clown drawn directly on the metal.

Under the paper is a long GAME CODE. This is probably a code you can use to return to a particular state in this game.

You put it in your inventory.
translation:
在海报后面是另一个小丑，直接画在金属板上。

在纸上有一个很长的秘籍码。这个秘籍可能让你能够回到游戏的某个特定状态。

你把他放进物品栏。

original: AD: Pounce on keys before they disappear.
translation: AD：赶在钥匙消失前飞扑抓住它。

original: You pick up the RING OF KEYS.
translation: 你拾起一串钥匙。

original: Ok, cool.
translation: OK，行。

original: Armed with your TOMMY GUN, you are one hard boiled lug. Nobody mess with this tough guy, see?
translation: 手握冲锋枪的你，是个铁石心肠的狠角色。没人敢惹这硬汉，明白了吗？

original: PS: Go into dumbwaiter so you can receive an item.
translation: PS：进入小货梯以取得一件物品。

original:
You go down the dumbwaiter.

Ace Dick tries to give you an item. But the HAMMER is too big to fit into the slot.

Ace gives you all his BUSINESS CARDS instead.

In return, you give him your collection of UNPLEASANT NOTES.
translation:
你乘货梯下行。

王牌老屌尝试给你东西，但是锤子太大塞不进缝隙。

作为替代，老屌把他所有的名片给了你。

你的回赠他那些没礼貌的小纸条。

original: AD: Examine notes.
translation: AD：检查纸条。

original:
You recognize both of these notes. You wrote and delivered them to your neighbor to get his goat.

One of them has something on the back. He wrote a rebuttal on the other side and taped it to the back of his fake safe for your viewing pleasure.

Luckily, the combination to your safe is on this paper. You carelessly composed your note on this document without noticing.
translation:
你认得这两张纸条。它们都是你写好送到邻居那边、为了激他生气用的。

其中一张背后有东西。是他在反面写了回怼的话，还把它贴在他那台假保险箱上，好让你看个够。

幸好，你的保险箱密码就写在这张纸上。你当时粗心大意，没注意到就拿这份文件来写纸条了。

original: AD: Use it to open safe.
translation: AD：用它打开保险箱。

original: You enter the combination. The smaller compartment opens up to reveal three old fashioned key holes.
translation: 你输入密码。最小的隔间打开，露出三个老式钥匙孔。

original: AD: Go look through pig painting to see what PS is up to.
translation: AD：透过猪画作看看PS在干什么。

original: You have to unplug your large panoramic window from its portable generator first.
translation: 你需要先把你那大号全景视窗的电源线从它的携带式发电机拔下来。

original: Unplug window.
translation: 拔掉窗户的电源。

original: Look through holes.
translation: 从洞里看过去。

original: AUGH.
translation: 啊呀。

original: You topple backwards on to your particle board desk. It was supported by a couple of smaller busts, including one of your favorites, Snoop Dogg from Soul Plane.
translation: 你踉跄几步，撞上身后的胶合板书桌。它是由几个小点的半身像支撑起来的，其中包括你最爱的那座，来自《空前绝后满天飞》的Snoop Dogg。

original: AD: Throw Snoop Dogg through big window portal.
translation: AD：把Snoop Dogg扔进大号窗户传送门。

original:
First you organize all of the particle board into a neat pile to reduce clutter.

You ready the Snoop for throwing.
translation:
你先把所有刨花板收拾成整齐的一堆。

你准备好扔出Snoop了。

original: Throw.
translation: 扔。

original:
The bust crumbles against the rigid surface of the unplugged window. There's just no breaking the plane unless it's plugged in.

Amidst the rubble is a couple pieces of CANDY CORN, and a SMALL KEY.
translation:
胸像撞上了断电窗户的坚硬表面，碎掉了。如果不插电就不可能破开面板。

在一堆破烂中埋着几块玉米糖，还有一把小钥匙。

original: AD: Examine the cruet next to the Snoop Dogg bust.
translation: AD：检查Snoop Dogg半身像边上的小瓶。

original:
First you plug the window back in so you stop stubbing your toe on things. Stubbing your toe is known to be brutal on your PULCHRITUDE stat.

You pick up the CRUET OF BRANDY.
translation:
首先你把窗户插上线，不然老是撞脚趾头。撞脚趾头可是会对你的魅力值造成毁灭性打击。

你拾起白兰地瓶。

original: AD: Examine rope.
translation: AD：检查绳索。

original: You pick up the ROPE.
translation: 你拾起绳索。

original: AD: Use tommygun on safe keyholes.
translation: AD：对保险箱钥匙孔使用冲锋枪。

original: You use your RING OF KEYS to unlock the key holes on the safe.
translation: 你使用你的钥匙串解锁保险箱的钥匙孔。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: The RING OF KEYS blows a hole in the safe. The safe is open.
translation: 钥匙串在保险箱上轰出一个洞，保险箱打开。

original: AD: Throw hammer through window.
translation: AD：把锤子扔到窗外。

original:
Now that the window is plugged in, you may effectively vent your rage with a heavy object.

The HAMMER shatters the glass and falls to the street far below your penthouse office suite .
translation:
既然窗户已经插电了，你终于可以痛快地拿个重物来发泄怒火了。

锤子击碎了玻璃，随后从你顶层办公室的高处坠落到街道上。

original: Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: AD: Get candy corn in preparation of your own vampire act.
translation: AD：拿来玉米糖，为你的吸血鬼行为预备。

original: You pick up CANDY CORN and SMALL KEY.
translation: 你拾起玉米糖和小钥匙。

original: PS: Look through clown picture at Ace.
translation: PS：通过小丑画看老屌。

original: AD: Candy corn vampire.

Ace Dick ate the candy corn.

He is an unimaginative lout and an all-around wet blanket!
Next.
translation: 下一页。

original:
Ace enjoys a small boost in PULCHRITUDE from the candy. His modest PULCHRITUDE gauge is now maxed out.

He inadvertently swallowed the SMALL KEY along with the CANDY CORN. It is now safely stored in his stomach.
AD: Build fort.

You figure it's time to do something constructive for a change.

Your stout bunker of particle board is a smashing success. The Zoolander chimney is the jewel in its crown.
AD: See what you have stashed in the safe.

You can't reach the opening!

You would stand on the chair, but you don't think it's quite high enough. Besides, it is now built into your fort, and there's obviously no going back.
AD: Throw fort out window.
That's the stupidest idea you've ever had!
AD: Use bust stand as a step to access the safe.
By stacking two bust stands, you can easily reach the safe opening.
Go in.

It's your secret hideaway, a great place for ducking into when being persecuted by unscrupulous whores.

Acrid fumes from the room fill your nostrils.
Go up dumbwaiter.
Next.
translation: 下一页。

original:
The dumbwaiter goes up, revealing the PHONE PARTS which had fallen down the shaft earlier.

While you're at it, you compose another UNPLEASANT NOTE on the back of one of the others, and slip it through the slot.
PS: Get phone parts and hook them up to your phone.

Your phone is now 2/3 complete.

It is ringing again! You're going to need that receiver!
AD: Exit dumbwaiter.
Open door lock with tommygun.

You throw your RING OF KEYS at the lock. They jangle uselessly against the door.

You're not sure what you expected was going to happen. You sure can be dumb sometimes.

The RING OF KEYS ammo is down to 90%.
Pick up keys.
You pick up your TOMMY GUN.
AD: Use rope to escape office through window.

You won't need to use the ROPE to escape through the window. There is a fire escape stairway.

You climb on to the generator, out the window, and on to the stairs.

The generator is chugging away. It is fueled by potent grain alchohol. Its fuel gauge is at 80%.
Go down stairs.
Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: The stairs end at the roof of an adjacent building. There is a pulley on the other side. There is a small skylight window on the center of the roof.
Look in window.

It's Pickle Inspector, the poor sap trapped in his office by that petty bastard, Problem Sleuth. He is currently in his fort.

There is no light in his office. His skylight window must not be powered.
Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: You suddenly feel weird about standing on the other side of an unpowered window. You feel as though there will probably be metaphysical consequences.
Next.
translation: 下一页。

original: A frightening beast appears!!!
PS: Alert Pickle Inspector to turn on his window.
You have a feeling your portly ally is in trouble somehow. You pound against the wall, but the Inspector is in his fort, off in his own world.
PS: Drink whiskey and go into fort.

You decide to take the matter up with him directly.

You take a healthy swig from your FLASK OF WHISKEY to boost your IMAGINATION, and duck into the old fort.
AD: Address this beast situation.
AD: Appease the beast by doing the truffle shuffle.

In a stirring homage to the tubby boy "Chunk" in The Goonies, you lift your shirt and produce the most blubber-jostling jig you can muster.

You are quickly slain by the hungry beast.
AD: No, wait, never mind.
You really like The Goonies, and you think the beast probably does too, but you think a little restraint is called for in this situation.
AD: Use your KEYS to kill the beast.

You squeeze the trigger of your TOMMY GUN and fill the creature with lead.

The beast is unfazed! You are down to only 5% ammo, and you doubt the remainder of your bullets will finish off the encroaching monster.
AD: Get the fuck out of here!!!
You run up the stairs into the safety of your window.
AD: Vomit up key.

You can't just vomit things on command! That's ridiculous.

On the other hand, when there's liquor in your system, that's a different story...
AD: Take a healthy swig of whiskey to restore some vim.

Well, ok, it's not whiskey, but you decide to open your CRUET OF BRANDY and throw back a stiff belt.

The alcohol has no effect on your VIM characteristic. But it quickly maxes out your crude little IMAGINATION gauge.

The room starts spinning. You'll need to duck into a safe place to expend the IMAGINATION fast.
AD: Go into fort.
Next.

You are standing in your imaginary office.

You can hardly believe how shitty your imagination is.
AD: Pick up poorly drawn gun.
You pick up the SHITTY GUN. You'd be shocked if it worked at all.
AD: Head over to PI's place for imaginary mixer.
Problem Sleuth is already there, trying to get into the locked office.
AD: Knock furiously on the door.
You shatter the glass with your beefy fist.
Look inside.
It is Pickle Inspector's imaginary office. He sure knows how to live it up.
Next.

He uses his potent imaginitive powers to replace the broken door with one of solid steel.
